name: Optimize IPv6 Address Handling
description: Improves routing consistency by disabling temporary IPv6 addresses.
commands:
netsh interface ipv6 set privacy state=disabled
netsh interface ipv6 set global randomizeidentifier=disabled
revert22H2:
netsh interface ipv6 set privacy state=enabled
netsh interface ipv6 set global randomizeidentifier=enabled
revert23H2:
netsh interface ipv6 set privacy state=enabled
netsh interface ipv6 set global randomizeidentifier=enabled
revert24H2:
netsh interface ipv6 set privacy state=enabled
netsh interface ipv6 set global randomizeidentifier=enabled
revertCommands:
netsh interface ipv6 set privacy state=enabled
netsh interface ipv6 set global randomizeidentifier=enabled
